This '''[[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]]''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|commander]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and served as the apprentice to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name="DYD" />

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Padawan was dispatched to rescue and protect [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when it came under attack, and to uncover the one responsible for the plot.<ref name="DYD" /> The Padawan served alongside their master Ti as protectors for the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during the crisis.

The Padawan would later join [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] to investigate the plot in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] on Coruscant, and would learn that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Vogg Barakk]] was in Shack Town.<ref name="DYD" /> The team captured and interrogated him before learning that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] hired him which prompted the Padawan to go to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to meet with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. It was there that the Jedi discovered that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] had lied to the Hutt that the Jedi had come to kill him, but the Padawan manages to persuade Jabba otherwise while Ventress fled the planet.<ref name="DYD" />
